title: Enforce CEO platform scope, licensing and budget mandate in core CI and rules
goal: Remove core macOS and ARM64 CI workflows (platform-check.yml, nightly.yml, windows-arm64.yml, windows-arm64-probe.yml), remove release.yml native-platforms dispatch, remove auto-merge-pr.sh platform-check dispatch, remove nightly.yml check from check-zc-matrix.sh, and align AGENTS.md and CI workflow tests so core CI runs only on vanilla Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64 while keeping source portable.
